discovery: The first local diagnostic implementation set the next eligible signal bar to exit_bar + 1. That imposed an unregistered extra one-minute lockout after a position had already exited at the exit_bar open.
causal_rule: A position that exits at the open of minute t is absent during minute t. Information from minute t becomes available only at its close, so a signal formed on minute t may causally enter at the open of minute t+1. Signals with signal_bar < exit_bar remain suppressed; signal_bar == exit_bar is eligible.
change: Set the global slot release marker to exit_bar, not exit_bar + 1.
reason_not_tuning: This follows directly from the preregistered next-open information boundary and one-global-slot contract. It is independent of signal family, parameter values and observed profitability.
invalidated_output: All local diagnostic candidate metrics computed before this correction are excluded from Result Registry, ranking and validation evidence.
